title: CROWDGUARD v2.0 Phase 5.1 Real-Time Delivery & Resilience Report

environment.delivery_mechanism: FastAPI WebSocket + Thread-Safe Broadcaster + Replay Buffer

resilience_and_recovery_tests.name: Single Camera Disconnection Fault Isolation
resilience_and_recovery_tests.description: Verifies that Cam A disconnect raises is_stale=True and broadcasts CAMERA_DISCONNECTED without crashing Cam B.
resilience_and_recovery_tests.evidence: Cam A marked disconnected and stale; Cam B session fully isolated.

resilience_and_recovery_tests.name: Camera Reconnection & State Reset
resilience_and_recovery_tests.description: Verifies that stream reconnection resets exponential risk smoother to 0.0 and emits CAMERA_RECONNECTED.
resilience_and_recovery_tests.evidence: Risk smoother reset to 0.0 on reconnect.

resilience_and_recovery_tests.name: WebSocket Client Disconnect Fault Isolation
resilience_and_recovery_tests.description: Verifies that an abrupt subscriber disconnect does not interrupt event publication or cause thread deadlocks.
resilience_and_recovery_tests.evidence: Broadcaster continued publishing without exceptions after client removal.

resilience_and_recovery_tests.name: Reconnection & Missed-Event Replay from Buffer
resilience_and_recovery_tests.description: Verifies that clients passing ?last_event_id retrieve all intervening events in exact causal order.
resilience_and_recovery_tests.evidence: Replayed 2 missed events in exact sequential order.

resilience_and_recovery_tests.name: Slow Consumer Queue Bounding & Oldest-Drop Protection
resilience_and_recovery_tests.description: Verifies that slow clients cannot cause unbounded memory growth; oldest messages are dropped with O(1) bound.
resilience_and_recovery_tests.evidence: Queue bounded to maxsize=5; 7 oldest events dropped cleanly without blocking publisher.

resilience_and_recovery_tests.name: Continuous Hazard Deduplication (Category A & B)
resilience_and_recovery_tests.description: Verifies that ongoing hazards past 4.0s cooldown increment repeat_event_count without minting duplicate tickets.
resilience_and_recovery_tests.evidence: Original incident inc_8c113d31c8 updated with repeat_event_count=2, is_continuation=True.

resilience_and_recovery_tests.name: Incident Acknowledgement & Resolution Real-Time Push
resilience_and_recovery_tests.description: Verifies that status transitions from Open -> Acknowledged -> Resolved broadcast real-time events to all subscribers.
resilience_and_recovery_tests.evidence: Broadcast INCIDENT_ACKNOWLEDGED and INCIDENT_RESOLVED verified with matching incident_id.

CAMERA_RECONNECTED emitted; risk smoother reset to 0.0
